text:
Zac Jones has been back in the NHL for a week and has already made some noise. Recalled on Nov. 10, the 26-year-old defenseman scored twice on Saturday against San Jose, beating Yaroslav Askarov, in a 6-5 overtime loss. CBS Sports called him a surprising source of offense, and that's fair: he had four goals in 115 games with the Rangers before this.

Three games tell us almost nothing, but the early signs are tidy. With him on the ice at five on five, Utah has taken 67.9% of the expected goals, and his ice time has climbed from 11 to 16 minutes across the three games. The shooting will cool (two goals on seven shots against a usual rate near 7%).

Evolving-Hockey's note on his last NHL season is kinder than his results: the chances were there, the finishing and goaltending around him weren't. Utah has lost all three games he's played, each by a goal. Whether he sticks may depend on how quickly those one-goal games start turning.
